technology.value: Deep-sea water Cherenkov neutrino telescope: photomultiplier tubes in pressure-resistant glass spheres (optical modules) on vertical mooring lines
technology.quote: The telescope infrastructure consisted of 12 flexible detector lines, holding photomultiplier tubes in glass spheres.

instrumented_volume.quote: The construction for the 0.02 km³-scale detector started in 2006 and was completed in 2008.

depth_min.note: Single mooring depth (not a range) is reported.

summary.plain: Twelve long cables strung with light-sensing glass spheres, anchored to the Mediterranean seabed off Toulon, France. Together they watched a huge volume of seawater for the faint blue light that a neutrino leaves behind.
summary.technical: 12-line, 885-OM deep-sea water-Cherenkov neutrino telescope, ~0.02 km³ instrumented volume, at 2475 m depth off Toulon, France. Operated from first-line deployment (2006-02-14) to switch-off (2022-02-12).
